zh.title: 國防部偵獲11架次共機與8艘共艦 7架次越中線
zh.summary: 國防部統計台海周邊偵獲11架次共機與8艘共艦；其中7架次逾越海峽中線。
body: 台灣國防部發布最新共機艦動態，統計自8月15日上午6時起至8月16日上午6時止，於台海周邊偵獲共機11架次、共艦8艘及公務船2艘，持續在周邊活動。對此，國軍運用任務機艦與岸置飛彈系統進行嚴密監控與應處。
在偵獲的11架次共機中，有7架次逾越台灣海峽中線，侵擾北部及中部空域。另據本站統計紀錄，前一日8月15日偵獲共機4架次、共艦8艘與公務船1艘；近30日單日最高紀錄則為7月30日的共機10架次。

en.title: Taiwan Detects 11 PLA Aircraft and 8 Vessels; 7 Sorties Cross Strait Median Line
en.summary: Taiwan's defence ministry detected 11 PLA aircraft and 8 vessels; 7 sorties crossed the strait median line.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense reported military activity around the Taiwan Strait from 06:00 on August 15 to 06:00 on August 16. During this period, defense forces detected 11 PLA aircraft, 8 PLA naval vessels, and 2 official ships operating in the surrounding waters and airspace. Taiwan's military deployed mission aircraft, naval vessels, and shore-based missile systems to monitor and respond to the movements.

Among the 11 PLA aircraft detected, 7 sorties crossed the Taiwan Strait median line, entering northern and central airspace. According to AVWIRE statistical records, 4 PLA aircraft, 8 naval vessels, and 1 official ship were recorded on August 15, while the 30-day single-day high was 10 PLA aircraft on July 30.
